Refine citation tier rule: top-tier journals (not Nature-only)

PI directive 2026-05-04 (refinement of original directive): the citation
tier rule applies to ANY framing paragraph (intro / abstract / related-work
intro / discussion intro / rebuttal framing), not only the introduction's
paragraph 1. The first 3-5 references MUST be from top-tier journals,
prioritizing 2024-2026 publications.

  Nature, Science, Cell, Neuron, PNAS, NEJM,
  Nat Neurosci, Nat Med, Nat Methods, Nat Biomed Eng, Nat Commun,
  Sci Adv, Sci Transl Med, Cell Reports / other Cell Press journals.

Updates:
  - Critical decisions #4: rule promoted from 'paragraph 1 funnel only'
    to ANY framing paragraph; top-tier set explicitly listed.
  - DO section: explicit forcing rule added for fresh-session work
    (paper revisions, additional sections, reviewer rebuttals).

Why this matters: future fresh-session agents writing abstract / related-
work intro / discussion / rebuttals would otherwise lack a binding rule
and might cite arbitrary venues. PI directive needs explicit codification
in CLAUDE.md DO section to be reliably enforced.
